1/A-type or steeper low-A terms, not a simple polynomial.

A full monomial basis in A and t (exponents −3 to 3 and 0 to 5) reaches NMSE about 1e-6, but the coefficients are large and cancel. That suggests the true law is non-polynomial, possibly involving an exponential or a rational function of A.
